postureMeaning: Default is KEEP THE ART. An undecided row destroys nothing and queues no work. Only 'cut' removes a weapon; 'regen'/'rescale' queue art work. 'prio' (A/B/C) is the regeneration ORDER and is meaningful only on a regen/rescale row. 'note' is free text and outranks everything else.
criterion: px-per-cell — how the shipping art holds up at drawSize x 64, plus a LEXICAL modern-Earth-name test. Ranks QUALITY and flags a shortlist; it cannot rank WORTH. Whether a weapon belongs in the Star Wars register is the owner's call and lives in the notes.
